svg.title: A symbol row can be reused; its frame slot cannot
svg.desc: Three compiler snapshots show inner x, block exit, and a subsequent y declaration. The live row count changes from 2 to 1 to 2, but the next-slot counter changes from 2 to 2 to 3. Lookup for x returns the inner row B+1 before exit and the outer row B afterward. y reuses row B+1 but gets slot 2 at RBP minus 24. A separate runtime timeline shows the inner object lifetime ending at its block exit while the entire 256-byte frame remains reserved until the epilogue.
svg.text: A row can be reused. Its slot cannot.
Block exit changes lookup. The function’s frame stays reserved.
row B → slot 0. B = file-scope row count, including this function.
Live symbol records → assigned frame locations
One invocation of the emitted function
Reserved bytes do not keep it alive.
Parsing } emits no stack adjustment. The epilogue restores RSP from RBP.
